articles.summary: Arch Manning remains Texas’ starting quarterback, but the pressure surrounding the Longhorns’ struggling offense is intensifying ahead of Saturday’s showdown with Ole Miss. According to ESPN, Texas planned to give backup quarterback KJ Lacey Jr. an increased share of first-team repetitions during practice this week, a development that could leave the redshirt freshman better prepared to step in if Manning struggles again. Meanwhile, a resurfaced video showcasing Lacey’s footwork has fueled excitement among Texas fans eager to see what the young quarterback could bring to the offense. With the No. 19 Longhorns hosting No. 7 Ole Miss at Darrell K. Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium, the quarterback conversation has become one of the biggest storylines surrounding the game.

articles.title: MMA fighter’s victory turns painful after referee lands on his leg during TKO
articles.summary: An MMA fighter’s hard-earned victory turned into a frightening scene when a referee accidentally landed on his leg while rushing to stop the fight, leaving the victorious competitor writhing in pain inside the cage. Kim Ji-young had just secured a second-round stoppage against Kim Jun-woo at Top Fighting Championship’s Top FC 24: Breakthrough event in Seoul, South Korea. But moments after the decisive strike, the referee’s intervention appeared to injure Ji-young’s leg, abruptly ending what should have been a triumphant moment. Footage of the incident circulated on social media, drawing attention to the unusual sequence and raising questions about the risks officials face when stepping between fighters during a stoppage.
